text:
Alex: Quick poll — sunrise showdown tomorrow? 6:30am at the lobby: sprint (5k) vs yoga flow (30m). Also thinking a short boulder session after for anyone who wants. Show of hands/emoji and I'll finalize plan :sunrise:

Maria: Yoga for me! Need to stretch out after desk-sitting. Will bring mat :person_in_lotus_position:

Josh: Run for me — 5k tempo. Can someone bring a headlamp? I might roll in straight from a late shift.

Sam: Split sounds perfect: 20m gentle yoga then a 3–4k easy run. Low-key. :ok_hand:

Lee: If we do climbing after I'm in for ~7:30. I can reserve the small wall if we have 4 ppl. Shoe sizes? I'll bring a crash pad and a couple of quickdraws for the top-rope.

Alex: Cool. React: :thumbsup: = sprint, :raised_hands: = yoga, :handshake: = split. Also react with :mountain_bicyclist: (or comment) if you're up for after-session boulder.

Maria: Reacted :raised_hands:. Also FYI HR covers one fitness class per person per month — I can submit the yoga booking if we want an instructor.

Josh: Reacted :thumbsup: (thanks for the HR heads-up). Headlamp: I have one spare if someone needs.

Sam: Reacted :handshake: — bringing gels + spare headlamp. Will bring a foldable mat too.

Lee: Reacted :mountain_bicyclist: . Shoe sizes i've got so far: Sam 9, Josh 10.5, Alex 9.5, Lee 10. Can others DM me sizes?

wellness-bot: Reminder: Lobby doors open 6:20am. Mask optional in common areas. (Automated message)

Alex: Sweet. Looks like split is winning. I'll book the small conference room for a guided 20m flow at 6:30, then we'll run the waterfront loop (meet back 7:20) and Lee will handle climbing sign-up for 7:30. Ping me if you need to swap. :sparkles:

Maria: Thanks Alex! :heart:

Josh: See you at 6:25 for warmup.

Sam: I'll post a quick Strava route after the run and add pace notes.

Lee: Booked the wall for 7:30–8:15, capacity 6. If more folks show up we'll do rotations. :mountain:

Alex: Final check — who needs a mat or headlamp loaner? Call it out now.

Maria: Mat ok. No lamp.

Josh: Need a lamp just in case. Thanks Sam/Josh? (edited)
